title: Planet of the Vapes Lobo
description:
POTV Lobo: A new standard in vaporization

We’re setting a new standard with a portable vaporizer that’s primed with a rich feature set and top-of-the-line performance for just $214.95.

We took years of vape experience and expert knowledge and meshed them together to give you a product that can compete with some of the best on the market, without straining your wallet.

– Rich, potent vapor
– Access to POTV’s signature glass collection
– Removable battery
– USB-C charging
– Dosing capsule included
– And more!

World Class vapor for all

Designed and built by experts, the Planet of the Vapes Lobo dry herb vaporizer was made with the user in mind. It’s made for any and all types of users that are hungry for a world class vaping experience at an affordable price point.

From potent sips to lung-busting rips, the Lobo is designed for the light users that just want to dip their toes in a bit, heavy users that want the fullest extraction, and everyone in between.

Experience top-shelf vapor quality alongside some of our favorite features like precise temperature control, a user-replaceable battery, and access to our suite of glass accessories.

Top tier vapor at half the price

Flavorful, Cloudy, Smooth, Efficient. We engineered the POTV Lobo with dynamic hybrid heating to extract as much out of your herb as possible, delivering the best vapor possible. To us that means that you get cloudy smooth flavorful hits from your first hit through the entire session – no fancy technique required.

Inhale the best: quality vapor, every time

We’re all about the vapor. That’s why we designed the Lobo with a clean, isolated airpath free of any silicone using quality materials like PEEK, titanium, stainless steel, and glass – read more about this here.

Elevate your sessions with POTV Glass

Experience the glass difference with the Lobo and our signature collection of glass accessories (sold separately).

Push your sessions to the max with your favorite tabletop bubbler and the water pipe adapter or cool your potent sessions on the go with a mini bubbler. If you’re feeling a little discreet, relax with a bent glass stem or cool it down with one of our dimpled stems. The Lobo allows you to customize your experience and have fun with Glass!

Learn all about our Glass Accessories in our POTV Glass Guide.

Battery that lasts, sessions that don’t quit

Take your vaping marathons even further with up to 10 sessions per charge through the POTV Lobo vaporizer. Test your limits with a reliable 18650 3500mAh battery that ensures long-lasting, uninterrupted performance through the heaviest of sessions – wherever you are. And when you’re running low, quickly fill up with fast USB-C charging or keep the session going with a replaceable battery.

Swappable batteries for the win!

Dead battery? No problem. Skip the charge times and jump right back into your session with a quick and easy swap of the battery. Just unscrew the battery lid, replace the dead battery, and you’ll never have to worry about your vape becoming an expensive paperweight (seriously…batteries don’t last forever).

Portable powerhouse: big vapor, anytime, anywhere

The Lobo is deceiving. It’s small, but it packs a punch. The size is perfect for on the go, but the vapor is so good you’ll reach for it at home. With a .2 gram oven capacity and 10 sessions per charge, it may be the only vape you ever need.

Plus, it comes with a dosing capsule for quick and easy loading wherever you are. This little pod is perfect for precise doses or prefilled sessions anywhere, but it also helps keep your bowl clean for easy maintenance and a fresher vape.

Top-tier vapor in 40 seconds

Go from cold to dense, milky vapor in under a minute. The POTV Lobo reaches 390°F / 198°C from cold in about 40 seconds and performs even faster when it’s already warm and ready to go.

Vaping made effortless

The Lobo is an effortless, vapor machine. We want high quality vapor to be accessible to everyone without special, hard-to-learn techniques. Whether you’re a microdoser or into all day sessions, take small sips or huge draws, the Lobo just delivers great vapor with full extraction.

With a simple button interface and a screen that tells you everything you need to know, the Lobo is designed to give you the results you want with seamless ease of use.

Stay fresh with an easy to clean design

A clean vape is essential for the best flavor and performance. That’s why we designed the Lobo to be extremely simple to clean and maintain, with only a few pieces to look after.

The dosing capsule is also designed to keep your vape fresher and cleaner for longer. Messes are contained within the capsule, and when it’s time, all you need to clean is the capsule and your glass piece!

Read our in-depth review

“The Planet of the Vapes Lobo dry herb vaporizer is a breath of fresh air in a highly populated market.”

User manual

Download the POTV Lobo User Manual here.

Warranty

The POTV Lobo vaporizer comes with a 2-year warranty when purchased from Planet of the Vapes plus a special 100-day return policy, backed by their 100% Satisfaction Guarantee.

You’ve got 100 days to test it out and if you don’t like it, you can return for a full refund or swap it out for another vape.

Concentrates disclaimer

The POTV Lobo works with concentrates when used with the included concentrate pad. Concentrates can spill and run down into the heater and damage your vape if you’re not careful. Use only a very small amount.
